title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
abstract: arXiv:2610.29578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets listed on Polymarket between January 2023 and May 2026, and only information available at listing (the market's title and description, named resolution source, and contract metadata), we predict lifetime trading volume and whether settlement is later disputed. Contract information predicts trading volume well (out-of-sample $R^2 = 0.747$ for log volume), and most of the signal is interpretable: market topic provides the largest gain ($+0.289$ $R^2$ over a $0.220$ contract-feature baseline), wording and resolution-rule design add smaller but measurable improvements ($+0.027$ combined), and neural text models add little beyond the interpretable features. translated_title: 预测市场合约在上线时能揭示什么：交易量与争议风险
translated_abstract: 基于Polymarket上2023年1月至2026年5月间802,863个已结算市场的近乎全量数据，仅使用上线时可获得的信息（市场的标题与描述、指定的结算来源以及合约元数据），我们预测其生命周期内的交易量以及结算日后是否会被争议。合约信息能很好地预测交易量（对数交易量的样本外R²=0.747），且大部分信号是可解释的：市场主题贡献了最大增益（相比0.220的合约特征基线，R²提升+0.289），措辞与结算规则设计带来较小但可测量的改进（合计+0.027），而神经文本模型在可解释特征之外几乎没有额外增益。这一性能无法在伴随上线格式转变的平台变革期中延续：预测市场交易量是否达到1,000美元的准确率从同期评估下的AUC 0.940下降至跨期训练评估时的0.577（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 仅凭预测市场合约上线时的可解释信息（如市场主题、措辞和结算规则）即可高度准确地预测其未来交易量与结算争议风险，但这种预测能力会随平台环境和上线格式的变化而显著衰减。
en_tdlr: Using only interpretable launch-time contract information such as market topic, wording, and resolution rules, one can accurately predict a prediction market's future trading volume and dispute risk, though this predictive power degrades sharply across platform regime changes.
